cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center to Google
cards.body: Crusoe has divested its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google, highlighting the challenges of developing massive AI infrastructure. The deal underscores mounting pressures in the data center development landscape.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $11B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI has reportedly secured an additional $11 billion in funding as part of an ongoing round expected to close in coming weeks. The raise values the company at $1.25 trillion.

cards.title: Artex AI Hacking Tools Exposed Online
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting Artex penetration testing tools publicly exposed to the internet. The breach allowed unrestricted access to the hacking platform.

cards.title: Meta Launches Spaces for Muse Agents
cards.body: Meta introduced Spaces, a new collaboration feature for its Muse AI agents. The tool enables users to interact with AI helpers in fresh ways.

cards.title: Midterm Elections May Reshape AI Industry
cards.body: Democrats' midterm victories could transform tech policy, with 40 of 41 data center ballot measures voting for restrictions. Growing voter opposition threatens future AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: AI Industry Faces Rough Two Years Ahead
cards.body: Midterm results show strong public opposition to data center development across the U.S. Policy shifts could challenge AI industry growth projections.

cards.title: AI Spending Stalls Despite Rising Usage
cards.body: Ramp data reveals AI usage is climbing while spending has plateaued, driven by price cuts and smarter cost controls. The slowdown could challenge investor hypergrowth assumptions as Anthropic nears IPO.

cards.title: Amazon Enables Text Commands for Alexa
cards.body: Amazon now allows users to text Alexa for shopping assistance, rolling out to millions in coming weeks. The feature expands Alexa's capabilities beyond voice interaction.

cards.title: Underdog Demos 32MB Speech Generation Model
cards.body: Underdog unveiled a remarkably compact 32MB model capable of generating both speech and music. The achievement shows progress in efficient AI model design.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M for Robot Simulation
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to bridge the sim-to-real gap for robotics using a digital goods pipeline. The approach aims to make digital environments realistic enough for robotic training.

cards.title: Palo Alto Networks Eyes Clutch Acquisition
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for $500 million. Clutch was previously valued at $85 million by investors Lightspeed and SignalFire.

cards.title: Airbnb Launching AI Travel Agent in 2027
cards.body: Airbnb announced its AI travel agent will launch in H1 2027 to help plan trips and manage bookings. The agent will assist users throughout their entire travel experience.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Avatar Now Accepts Video Calls
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI agent can now receive video calls as a customizable animated avatar. The feature previews Meta's upcoming Tamagotchi-like wearable device for Muse.

cards.title: Meta Warns Data Center Backlash Threatens AI
cards.body: Meta cautioned that growing political opposition to data centers could impede future AI infrastructure investments. Communities are increasingly resisting massive data center projects.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases Cybersecurity Model
cards.body: OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model amid scrutiny over AI labs' digital infrastructure protection efforts. The release addresses growing concerns about AI's role in security.

cards.title: OpenAI President Says IPO Possible in 2027
cards.body: OpenAI president Greg Brockman stated the company could be IPO-ready in 2027 at a Wall Street Journal conference. Brockman highlighted gains in the enterprise market where rival Anthropic has already succeeded.

cards.title: Claude Gains Personal Finance Analysis Tool
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude now offers Personal Finance, allowing users to connect bank and card accounts via Plaid. Users can ask AI-powered questions about their spending habits.

cards.title: Axiom Math Formally Verifies Stacks Project
cards.body: Axiom Math's AI agents formally verified the Stacks Project, one of mathematics' largest proof libraries. The startup aims to combat AI-generated mathematical misinformation through verification.

cards.title: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350M
cards.body: Dropbox acquired Tigris Data for $350 million to strengthen AI infrastructure capabilities. The deal supports development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform for AI developers.

cards.title: Aina Smart Ring Features Screen and Joystick
cards.body: Aina unveiled a smart ring equipped with a display, joystick, and microphone for AI agent interaction. The ring also enables calls and voice note dictation on Mac.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Arrives in SF
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is operating in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into AI-powered domestic automation. The technology demonstrates practical applications of robotics in everyday household tasks.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom Faces Political Uncertainty
cards.body: Texas, the fastest-growing US data center market, hosts major AI infrastructure buildouts but faces challenges from recent political shifts. Democratic victories in state elections could reshape energy policy affecting AI expansion.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Controls Powerful AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach using reverse game theory aims to keep advanced AI agents in check through strategic design principles. The method addresses control challenges as AI systems become increasingly autonomous.

cards.title: Securing Enterprise AI with Data Lineage
cards.body: Data lineage techniques help enterprises track and verify information used by AI agents across multiple systems. This approach prevents errors when AI agents pull data from restricted or archived sources.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Summoned by Congress Over Espionage
cards.body: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Congressional scrutiny over concerns regarding Chinese espionage and AI chip export controls. The hearing reflects heightened US government focus on AI hardware security and geopolitical tensions.
